svg.title: Per node or total: the first two request options
svg.desc: Worked comparison on a two-node job asking for four GPUs, allocation recipes, and option notes in Slurm.
svg.text: Per node or total: the first two request options
Worked comparison on a two-node job asking for four GPUs

text.tspan: per node; with --nodes=2 every node gets
Slurm decides the split, for example 2 plus 2,
or all four on one node;
can fragment placement and hurt NCCL,
use only for jobs that tolerate it
result N times 8 ranks, one GPU each
with an explicit -n, each task gets its own GPU
